description: TN.Water.WaterwayLink is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sjofartsverket.se. The data set reports links in the maritime network according to Inspiretema transportnetwork (TN) WaterwayLink. The dataset can be accessed via wms and wfs. Coverage: SE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
